notes: Single source of truth for PubMed discovery-window policy. retarats_v2.py reads its --datetype/--daily-days defaults from here; rules_version.py hashes this file as part of the scientific-retrieval-inputs fingerprint. datetype=edat (Entrez/indexing date) replaces the prior pdat default: a live pdat-vs-edat measurement (docs/retrieval_benchmark_review.md, local-only) across 8 sampled molecules at the production window found edat catching genuine on-topic PMIDs pdat missed entirely, with zero cases of pdat catching something edat missed -- an independent review confirmed 4 of those 5 edat-only PMIDs as true permanent pdat misses (indexing lagged the nominal pub date past the daily window); the overall decision to move to edat + a wider window stands. daily_days widened 8->14 as a safety margin against residual indexing lag; existing evidence_id dedup (retarats_pipeline/sinks.py PipelineState) makes the wider window free -- already-seen records are skipped, not re-processed. The weekly re-sweep of the current+previous year (datetype=edat) and the weekly retraction/erratum refresh (scripts/run_retraction_refresh.py) are both invoked directly from .github/workflows/update.yml, gated to Mondays; there is no separate scripts/run_pubmed_resweep.py -- the re-sweep reuses retarats_v2.py's existing --mode backfill with --start-year set to the previous year.
